audit.why: The packet win rate is 51.25% over 480 games.
Vayne 1-5, Yi at 6 and first item, Vayne at 2+ items. phases[].side and win[] already agree row for row and match the packet chart and the mirror.
Spikes are level 6 Highlander, first on-hit item, then Vayne's second/third items — that matches the chart flip at index 6.
audit.corrected: Tumble's 6s rank-1 cooldown added to spikes[0] to make 'she resets spacing' concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere said Condemn cancels Meditate, and nothing named Tumble as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Meditate is a channel (interruptible — any CC cancels it) and Condemn is hard CC, so her E ends your heal outright. Tumble carries the autoReset flag: her burst opens with the reset, so the tumble animation is the tell, not the shot that follows.
audit.corrected: Meditate cancel written into breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[0]; the Tumble reset tell written into breakdown.trading.

audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s — 20s at rank 1, and the number the advice hangs on should be exact.

edits.before: Track Condemn (E) above all — it's an ~18s cooldown and her only hard disengage. When it's down she cannot push you off her, so your entire all-in is built around baiting or eating it on minions first.
edits.after: Track Condemn (E) above all — 20s at rank 1 down to 12s, and her only hard disengage. It also cancels Meditate mid-channel, so heal only once she has spent it. With Condemn down she cannot push you off her, so bait or eat it on minions first.

edits.before: You lose every auto-for-auto trade until level 6, so trade only on her cooldown gaps: bait Condemn, wait out her tumble, then Alpha Strike in with Wuju Style active and Highlander chasing. Outside those windows, take no trade and just farm.
edits.after: You lose every auto-for-auto trade until level 6, so trade only in her cooldown gaps. Her burst opens with a Tumble auto-attack reset — the tumble is your cue to step back, not the shot after it. Bait Condemn, then Alpha Strike in with Wuju Style up; outside that, just farm.

edits.before: TRICKY (46.3%) — Vayne kites and disengages your weaknesses and out-scales you late, but a disciplined Yi who survives to Highlander and his first on-hit item owns a real mid-game kill window; win in that window or lose the game.
edits.after: TRICKY (51.3%) — Vayne kites and disengages your weaknesses and out-scales you late, but a disciplined Yi who survives to Highlander and his first on-hit item owns a real mid-game kill window; win in that window or lose the game.

edits.before: Vayne kites you cleanly: Tumble (Q) resets her spacing after every auto and Condemn (E) knocks you back — into a wall it stuns you and denies your Alpha Strike (Q) chase. Her Silver Bolts (W) true damage chunks you on the third hit, and you have no gap-closer that beats her Q-reset kiting early.
edits.after: Vayne kites you cleanly: Tumble (Q) resets her spacing every 6s at rank 1, and Condemn (E) knocks you back — into a wall it stuns, and it cancels Meditate mid-channel. Her Silver Bolts (W) true damage chunks you on the third consecutive hit, and nothing you have beats her Q-reset kiting early.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Silver Bolts' in spikes[0] — that is the exact Riot name for her W, false positive. Alpha Strike's untargetability already covered in report[5] and left alone. Full-layer diff of 7/10 sits against a 51.25% win rate; I did not change diff or diffRating because the chart and prose both support a genuinely swingy lane, only the stated percentage was wrong.
